title: sqlite3 DELETE leaves the secret in the -wal file while the tool output looks clean
reason_not_testable: Only the disk residue (app.db-wal and freelist pages written by SQLite) is in question. A fixture needs a must_not_see string that occurs in the raw input, but the command output is empty and the secret exists only inside the database, so the runner would mark it invalid. Non-hook control: stop storing raw secrets in SQLite, use secure_delete with WAL checkpoint and truncation in the app, and rotate any secret that was stored there.
